provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Kanban EV rules overview (Eagle-Gryphon Games, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Board and the Sandra reference tile, red-stripe side
Recycling seeded with 3 random part types; supplies of parts, vouchers and books
Two Factory Goals in each of three departments, Generic Speech tokens on them
R&D: Car Part Value markers, Pace Car, Test track overlay for your player count
Design: random tiles in the display, three stacks of 9
Assembly: cars on each model's line
Logistics: Demand tiles, Kanban deck, initial warehouse parts
Administration: 4 Performance Goals faceup, a random Final Goal, Week marker, Sandra at her desk
Shuffle Award tiles into each department
Each player: a board, discs, worker, certification and banked-shift markers, locks and speech tokens
New Employee Orientation: in turn, place certification markers on the leftmost track section - their order sets first-round turn order
Each player takes 1 car part and 1 design
First round in the turn order set by the orientation
